owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

MIN_COEFFICIENT.details: A discount deeper than 10% means the fair value and the market have diverged structurally; that is a decision to revisit the feed, not to dial further. A premium (> ONE) is never allowed: this contract only ever marks down.

ONE.details: Neutral coefficient: publish the pushed price unchanged.

PriceDiscounted(uint80,int256,uint256,in.notice: Emitted on every accepted checked push: what the pusher sent, the coefficient applied, and what was stored.

PriceSetUnchecked(uint80,int256,int256).notice: Emitted when the owner pushes a price without the deviation check. `checkPrice` is 0 when the check oracle was unavailable.

checkOracle().notice: The check feed, or `address(0)` while pushes are unchecked.

checkPrice().notice: The check feed's current price, normalised to this oracle's decimals. `ok` is false when the feed is unusable or unset.

checked().notice: Whether pushes are checked at all: false while `checkOracle` is unset.

coefficient().notice: The discount applied to every pushed price, 8 decimals. `1e8` is neutral (no discount).

discount(int256).notice: `raw` after the discount, as `setPrice` would store it. Reverts on the inputs `setPrice` would reject.

previewSetPrice(int256).notice: Whether `setPrice(raw)` would be accepted right now, and by how much the *discounted* value deviates from the check feed — the pusher passes the raw price here, exactly as it would to `setPrice`.

setCoefficient(uint256).notice: Sets the discount. Takes effect on the next push; the stored price is left alone, so changing the dial never publishes a value that was not checked against the feed.

setPrice(int256).notice: Discounts `raw` by `coefficient`, then stores it if the result sits within `maxDiffBps` of the check feed (or unconditionally while no check feed is set). Callable by the pusher or the owner.

setPriceUnchecked(int256).notice: Pushes `price` without consulting the check feed. Owner only; the escape hatch for a dead or wrong check feed.

userdoc.notice: A CheckedOracle that stores pushed prices at `coefficient` of their value, and checks the discounted value against the check feed. The pushed price is an off-chain fair value and the asset trades at a basis to it locally, so discounting keeps the published price near the market without widening the band. `setPriceUnchecked` is not discounted.
